offers.name: Intro call
offers.summary: Free. 20 minutes with Ryan. A straight answer on whether AI helps. Request it on the start form.

offers.name: Sidekick Session
offers.summary: 90 minutes on video. A 5-question form and access to one tool beforehand. Tool subscriptions stay on the client's accounts.
leaveWith: One workflow set up in the client's accounts
A one-page summary the next business day
The next three jobs, each with effort and monthly tool cost
The $500 credited in full to a Setup Sprint signed within 14 days

offers.name: Setup Sprint
offers.summary: Two or three workflows in two to three weeks, written how-tos, and a one-page AI policy. For owner-run businesses.

offers.name: Sidekick Monthly
offers.summary: A 30-minute weekly check-in, a running list worked from the top down, and a Friday one-page report. 3-month minimum. Optional 10-20% of measured gain on workflows the client's systems already track, capped at 1.5x the retainer.

offers.name: Quick Scan
offers.summary: For teams of 10 or more. Scheduled after a fit. Credited toward a build if you sign within 14 days.

offers.name: Build
offers.summary: For teams of 10 or more. Per workflow. Fixed quote after the Quick Scan. Half due at kickoff and half at launch.

tooling: Clients pay for tools, APIs and seats on their own accounts. Supergood does not resell or mark up software.
